markers.name: Cho'Rush the Observer
markers.notes: Shares the final encounter with King Gordok. Spare him for a full tribute run; numbers do not require killing every boss.

markers.name: Stomper Kreeg
markers.notes: Available after becoming king if Kreeg remains alive.

markers.name: Broken Trap
markers.notes: Repair with Frost Oil and a Thorium Widget to freeze Guard Slip'kik.

markers.name: Knot Thimblejack
markers.notes: Obtain the suit before freeing Knot if it is needed for this run.

markers.name: Captain Kromcrush
markers.notes: Quest interaction after becoming king if Kromcrush remains alive. Before the final encounter, the Gordok Ogre Suit can be used to send him away.

markers.to: I <-> II: courtyard door into the interior hall; the Gordok Courtyard Key is in the chest shown in panel I.
II <-> III: ramp from the lower hall to the platform above Knot Thimblejack.
III <-> IV: onward passage to Captain Kromcrush and Gordok's Seat.

symbols.name: Gordok Tribute
symbols.notes: Appears after the final encounter and the interaction with Mizzle the Crafty; exact position is schematic.

uncertain: Dashed corridors indicate documented connections with unverified bends, dimensions and orientation. Room outlines are schematic abstractions, not surveyed footprints.
The patrol paths of Mol'dar, Fengus and Slip'kik are not established; markers 1, 3 and 4 indicate search areas.
Exact positions of the trap, Knot, the tannin basket and the Kromcrush quest interaction are unverified; Q2-Q5 are area markers.
The detailed route from the upper platform to Kromcrush, including any intermediate landings, is unverified and is compressed into a dashed connection.
Both chest positions are schematic. The Athenaeum side connection is omitted until its junction and descending passage can be verified together with Dire Maul West.
No safe path around hostile packs or patrols is asserted. Tribute uses the same rooms; it is not a separate physical corridor.
